name: io.github.Chiru144/spotify-soundtrack-mcp
title: Spotify Soundtrack MCP
description: Spotify + TMDB tools: movie soundtrack playlists, playlist curation, taste stats and playback.

packageArguments.name: --transport
packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: SPOTIPY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Spotify app (https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Sign-in uses PKCE, so no client secret is needed.

environmentVariables.name: SPOTIPY_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: Redirect URI registered for your Spotify app.

environmentVariables.name: TMDB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TMDB v3 API key for movie, cast and filmography lookups. Set this or TMDB_READ_ACCESS_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: TMDB_READ_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: TMDB v4 Read Access Token, an alternative to TMDB_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: SPOTIFY_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to load: core, playback, playlists, search, taste, library, browse or all.
